body:
Deaths, returns, founders and public judgments can change the history around them. This review makes the scope of selected conclusions visible. Reviewed means the stated narrow conclusion was checked; it does not mean every related claim is settled.

Continue into the unresolved record for the evidence that could answer the remaining questions.

Leadership

corrected

Bowene already holds the High Lord title before Aria’s death. Aria’s cultural authority was distinct from that office.

Limit: The clarification does not establish a constitution, a new office or Bowene’s original accession procedure.

August quest receipt and explicit canon clarification, 18 October 2026

Limit: Disposition of remains alone does not establish permanent death for a lich.

reviewed

Nienna dies fighting soul eaters and wraiths on 9 July 2024. Saray recovers her body and obtains the diamond; Elenia casts Raise Dead on 15 July. The September sacrifice is separate.

Limit: The spell log documents the same return as the awakening. Nienna’s recollection of a struggle for her soul does not establish permanent consumption; Saray’s guilt stays attributed.
